content.text:
I fixed the four problems in `src/app/[slug]/wizard.tsx`. I haven't run axe or a browser, so the audit result is unconfirmed. `tsc` and `eslint` show nothing new; the one `tsc` error is `LayoutProps` in `layout.tsx`, which I didn't touch. I didn't run `pnpm test` or `pnpm build`.

- **Labels:** The date picker now has a visible "Date" label. Name and phone, in both "Your details" and the waitlist box, get visible "Name" and "Phone" labels tied to their inputs. I kept the placeholders and added `autoComplete` (`name`, `tel`) to those fields.
- **Contrast:** The service durations and "Loading…" moved from `zinc-400` to `zinc-600`, which is readable on white. The selected service keeps its light-on-dark duration text. I also darkened the input placeholders to `zinc-500`, which axe doesn't check but were pale.
- **Errors:** The shared error line (including "That time was just taken…" and "Check the name and phone…") and the waitlist error now have `role="alert"`. "Loading…" and the "You are on the waitlist" message use `role="status"`, so they're announced politely.
- **Selection:** Service and staff buttons now set `aria-pressed`, so assistive tech can tell which is selected. The visual styling is unchanged.

The new labels are visible text, so the layout shifts slightly. Nothing a sighted user saw before has been removed.
